An omitted `--zone-id` requires a unique zone mapping for the selected region.

| ----------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--nat-id`  | `string` | yes      |
| `--zone-id` | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode network get-nat-instance --nat-id <nat-id>
```

## get-network-acl

Kind: Read.

Sets `DefaultACL`, `VPCID`, `Rules`, and `SubnetIDs`. `list-network-acls` sets
`NetworkID` and `SubnetID`. Fields specific to the other read have zero values.

The detail response must contain explicit ACL state and unique subnet IDs. On a
server error, a complete ACL inventory must confirm absence before the command
reports `NotFound`.

| Flag               | Type     | Required |
| ------------------ | -------- | -------- |
| `--network-acl-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode network get-network-acl --network-acl-id <network-acl-id> --query ACL
```

## list-all-security-group-rules

Kind: Read.

Reads every security group page, up to 50 pages and 500000 groups. Repeated IDs
or pages, changing totals, and incomplete inventories return `InvalidResponse`
without partial output.

Each security group's response must contain an explicit rule array with valid,
unique rule IDs.

No fields.

```sh
greennode network list-all-security-group-rules
```

## list-network-prices

Kind: Read.

Quotes the public, public-vm, and public-mkp virtual IP types separately.
Floating IP, external-interface, and reservation prices remain unknown.
Bandwidth and NAT costs are excluded.

Use `--sort-by name` or `--sort-by monthly-price`. Unknown prices sort last.
Table and text coverage notes print on stderr.

The request limit defaults to 500, with a maximum of 2000. Discovery needs space
for three quotes and any uncached project lookup. With `--allow-partial`, usable
results print before the incomplete coverage error.

| Flag              | Type     | Required |
| ----------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--max-requests`  | `int`    |          |
| `--allow-partial` | `bool`   |          |
| `--descending`    | `bool`   |          |
| `--sort-by`       | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode network list-network-prices
```

## list-vpn-connections

Kind: Read.

Reads one page in `hcm-3` or `han-1`. Read-only profiles can run this command.
`--page` defaults to 1 and `--size` defaults to 10. No automatic paging occurs.
Live multi-page behavior remains unverified. Sites and tunnels are inline.

Table and text output use one row per VPN with compact JSON for nested fields.
The example selects site and tunnel counts. Status describes provisioning.
Pre-shared keys are omitted. Server error messages and codes are withheld.

| Flag     | Type  | Required |
| -------- | ----- | -------- |
| `--page` | `int` |          |
| `--size` | `int` |          |

```sh
greennode network list-vpn-connections --page 1 --size 10 \
  --query "Items[].{ID:UUID,Name:VPNName,Sites:length(VPNSites),\
Status:Status,Tunnels:length(VPNSites[].Tunnels[])}" --output table
```

## quote-create-endpoint

Kind: Read.

Reads a fresh monthly VND quote for one Gateway endpoint. Read-only profiles can
run this command.

Requires SDK IAM-user login and default endpoints in `hcm-3`. The existing VPC
and subnet must offer the selected Gateway endpoint.

Omitted catalog selectors use HCM03-1C, the sole default category,
vstorage.hcm03, and Standard. The JSON `MaxPrice` field does not cap the quote.

| Flag                                     | Type      | Required |
| ---------------------------------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--name`                                 | `string`  | yes      |
| `--vpc-id`                               | `string`  | yes      |
| `--subnet-id`                            | `string`  | yes      |
| `--availability-zone-id`                 | `string`  |          |
| `--category-id`                          | `string`  |          |
| `--service-id`                           | `string`  |          |
| `--package-id`                           | `string`  |          |
| `MaxPrice` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `float64` |          |

```sh
greennode network quote-create-endpoint --region hcm-3 --name demo --vpc-id <net-id> --subnet-id <sub-id>
```

## quote-create-nat-instance

Kind: Read.

Reads a fresh one-month prepaid VND quote. Read-only profiles can run this
command.

Use the regional zone from `list-v-network-regions`, the availability zone from
`list-nat-zones`, and the package UUID from `list-nat-packages`.

Requires NAT V3 enabledForAll mode. The JSON `MaxPrice` field does not cap the
quote.

| Flag                                     | Type      | Required |
| ---------------------------------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--name`                                 | `string`  | yes      |
| `--zone-id`                              | `string`  | yes      |
| `--availability-zone-id`                 | `string`  | yes      |
| `--package-id`                           | `string`  | yes      |
| `--vpc-id`                               | `string`  | yes      |
| `MaxPrice` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `float64` |          |

```sh
greennode network quote-create-nat-instance --name <name> --zone-id <zone-id> --availability-zone-id <availability-zone-id> --package-id <package-id> --vpc-id <vpc-id>
```
